structs.notes: Verdict partial: the size is bounded (73..80) but not proven, so the coordinator should accept 80 only if another proof (for example a FenceObject size from a FenceObject agent, or a copy or clear of the object) is found. Identity: the fence index 4 object, which the static vtable names NetworkingFence, is not proven to be the network fence; the function name came from earlier name matching and is kept. Other fence objects in the same table (DemonwareFence, UserSignedInToLiveFence, PublisherVariablesFence, LiveStorageFence) use the same 24-byte vtable record layout (GetFenceValue, UpdateIsPassingInternal, UpdateDependencies). A FenceObject struct agent should own the +0..+79 base fields.
